project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-11. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 2 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment completed 2026-08-11: 6 of 7 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; unresolved entries were individually checked and retained as unknown.

touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Launde qualifies as a local detour through Site of abbey church and claustral buildings and LAUNDE ABBEY. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Launde: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Launde offers Site of abbey church and claustral buildings, LAUNDE ABBEY, LAUNDE ABBEY: CHAPEL within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.
